title: 15.64. Rūpāvacaraduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Rūpāvacaraṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca narūpāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Narūpāvacaraṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca narūpāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
Narūpāvacaraṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca narūpāvacaro naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ. (Abyākatamūlaṁ dve paccayavasena.)
